title: Shuttle feedback-06: cabin wall steps, cargo orientation and landed reconnect
acceptance_criteria: Owned-character step probes test the current collision candidate rather than the unadvanced base position; generic movement bounds, true floor/ceiling contacts and legitimate native steps remain intact.

Cargo orientation uses the same authoritative frame parent as position, preserves world orientation on parent changes, synchronizes local orientation for late join and holds unknown or mismatched presentation safely.
Offline landing and Ready preserve the same living body, Mind and items; subsequent hatch checks distinguish actual paid power, projected reach and the normal E/bump dispatch paths.
Supported diagonal wall probes include actual native yaw and same-move floor/oblique-side evidence without bypassing the physical-attempt budget.

Fresh full JUnit, focused native integration and unfiltered native fixtures pass with clean saving/shutdown, without launching a client, changing owner configuration or packaging/installing an artifact.
manual_steps: Connected retesting requires an explicitly identified current client/server artifact; no installation or client launch is performed by this gate.
Walk diagonally and jump against all four interior walls; verify normal floor support and real ceiling head contact.
Watch distinctive jugs while the cabin turns, then reconnect and verify their local orientation remains consistent.
On a server that continues ticking, log out aboard a falling cabin, let it land, rejoin, and check the same body/Mind/items, floor position and powered hatch touch/E response.
